state: PROPOSED: not frozen until the operator approves them (D6). Nothing has been evaluated against them. They are frozen before qualification. The Java sample may change them before approval; a later calibration run would be identified as one and could not silently move a frozen limit.
basis: Limits sit about twice above the latest pilot, because latency moved up to 1.8 times between runs on this machine; those runs differ in more than noise, so this is a judgement and not a measured tolerance. K2 keeps the earlier probe's bounds and scales only its size.
